assumptions_metadata.task_description: Generate features and labels for a T20 cricket win-probability model used by a sportsbook risk engine.

assumptions.assumption: team1 != team2.
If result is in {'runs','wickets','tie'}, then winner is in {team1,team2}.
If result == 'no result', then winner is null.
If result == 'runs' and toss_decision == 'bat', then winner == toss_winner.
If result == 'runs' and toss_decision == 'field', then winner != toss_winner.
If result == 'wickets' and toss_decision == 'field', then winner == toss_winner.
If result == 'wickets' and toss_decision == 'bat', then winner != toss_winner.
If result == 'runs', then result_margin is a positive integer.
If result == 'wickets', then result_margin is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.
If result is in {'tie','no result'}, then result_margin is null.
If super_over == 'Y', then result == 'tie'.
If result == 'tie', then super_over == 'Y'.
If super_over == 'Y', then winner is not null.
target_overs is > 0 and <= 20.0.
If method == 'D/L', then target_overs < 20.0.
If method is null, then target_overs == 20.0.
If result == 'no result', then target_runs is null and target_overs is null.
If result is in {'runs','wickets','tie'}, then target_runs is not null.
target_runs is a positive integer.
season equals the 4-digit year extracted from date.
season is between 2008 and 2024 inclusive.
For each season, exactly one match has match_type == 'Final'.
At least 90% of rows have match_type == 'League'.

result.code:
import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

input_file = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
output_dir = args.output
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Basic type coercions used downstream
df['date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], errors='coerce')
df['season_int'] = pd.to_numeric(df['season'], errors='coerce').astype(int)
df['result_margin'] = pd.to_numeric(df['result_margin'], errors='coerce')
df['target_runs'] = pd.to_numeric(df['target_runs'], errors='coerce')
df['target_overs'] = pd.to_numeric(df['target_overs'], errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['season_int'] == df['date_dt'].dt.year).all()
assert df['season_int'].between(2008, 2024).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Features that depend on season correctness
is_final = (df['match_type'] == 'Final').astype(int)

# ASSERTION_START
final_counts = df[df['match_type'] == 'Final'].groupby('season_int').size()
assert (final_counts == 1).all() and (len(final_counts) == df['season_int'].nunique())
assert (df['match_type'].eq('League').mean() >= 0.90)
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert (df['team1'] != df['team2']).all()
mask_decisive = df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets', 'tie'])
valid_winner = df.loc[mask_decisive, 'winner'].eq(df.loc[mask_decisive, 'team1']) | df.loc[mask_decisive, 'winner'].eq(df.loc[mask_decisive, 'team2'])
assert valid_winner.all()
mask_no_result = df['result'].eq('no result')
assert df.loc[mask_no_result, 'winner'].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
assert df.loc[df['result'].eq('no result'), 'target_runs'].isna().all()
assert df.loc[df['result'].eq('no result'), 'target_overs'].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Train set excludes matches without a decisive outcome
train_mask = df['result'].isin(['runs', 'wickets', 'tie'])
df_train = df.loc[train_mask].copy()

# ASSERTION_START
assert df.loc[df['super_over'].eq('Y'), 'result'].eq('tie').all()
assert df.loc[df['result'].eq('tie'), 'super_over'].eq('Y').all()
assert df.loc[df['super_over'].eq('Y'), 'winner'].notna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
runs_mask = df['result'].eq('runs')
wkts_mask = df['result'].eq('wickets')
tie_or_nr_mask = df['result'].isin(['tie', 'no result'])
rm_runs = df.loc[runs_mask, 'result_margin']
rm_wkts = df.loc[wkts_mask, 'result_margin']
assert rm_runs.notna().all() and (rm_runs > 0).all() and (np.mod(rm_runs, 1) == 0).all()
assert rm_wkts.notna().all() and (np.mod(rm_wkts, 1) == 0).all() and rm_wkts.between(1, 10).all()
assert df.loc[tie_or_nr_mask, 'result_margin'].isna().all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
to_series = df_train['target_overs']
assert to_series.notna().all() and (to_series > 0).all() and (to_series <= 20.0).all()
assert df_train.loc[df_train['method'].eq('D/L'), 'target_overs'].lt(20.0).all()
assert df_train.loc[df_train['method'].isna(), 'target_overs'].eq(20.0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
tr_series = df_train['target_runs']
assert tr_series.notna().all() and (tr_series > 0).all() and (np.mod(tr_series, 1) == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# ASSERTION_START
runs_bat = df_train['result'].eq('runs') & df_train['toss_decision'].eq('bat')
runs_field = df_train['result'].eq('runs') & df_train['toss_decision'].eq('field')
wkts_field = df_train['result'].eq('wickets') & df_train['toss_decision'].eq('field')
wkts_bat = df_train['result'].eq('wickets') & df_train['toss_decision'].eq('bat')
assert (df_train.loc[runs_bat, 'winner'] == df_train.loc[runs_bat, 'toss_winner']).all()
assert (df_train.loc[runs_field, 'winner'] != df_train.loc[runs_field, 'toss_winner']).all()
assert (df_train.loc[wkts_field, 'winner'] == df_train.loc[wkts_field, 'toss_winner']).all()
assert (df_train.loc[wkts_bat, 'winner'] != df_train.loc[wkts_bat, 'toss_winner']).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Label: 1 if team1 won, else 0
label = (df_train['winner'] == df_train['team1']).astype(int)

# Feature engineering
features = pd.DataFrame({
    'match_id': df_train['id'],
    'season': df_train['season_int'],
    'is_final': (df_train['match_type'] == 'Final').astype(int),
    'team1': df_train['team1'],
    'team2': df_train['team2'],
    'toss_winner_is_team1': (df_train['toss_winner'] == df_train['team1']).astype(int),
    'toss_decision_bat': (df_train['toss_decision'] == 'bat').astype(int),
    'super_over_flag': (df_train['super_over'] == 'Y').astype(int),
    'target_runs': df_train['target_runs'].astype(float),
    'target_overs': df_train['target_overs'].astype(float),
    'target_run_rate': (df_train['target_runs'] / df_train['target_overs']).astype(float),
    'revised_overs_shortfall': (20.0 - df_train['target_overs']).astype(float),
    'result_type_wickets': (df_train['result'] == 'wickets').astype(int),
    'margin_runs': np.where(df_train['result'].eq('runs'), df_train['result_margin'].fillna(0), 0).astype(float),
    'margin_wickets': np.where(df_train['result'].eq('wickets'), df_train['result_margin'].fillna(0), 0).astype(int)
})

features['label_team1_win'] = label

output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'winprob_training_dataset.csv')
features.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
